verses.1: And in Tzalel, he made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was one and a half cubits, its width also one and a half cubits, and its height also one and a half cubits.
verses.2: And he saw pure gold from both inside and outside the house. He made for him golden rings around it.
verses.3: And he carved four gold ornaments on each of its four corners. Two ornaments were also carved on one of its sides, and two ornaments were carved on the other side.
verses.4: And he made the handles from wood, and he covered them with gold.
verses.5: And he brought the barrows onto the sides of the mountain, in order to carry the load.
verses.6: And he made a golden canopy, with a length of half an arka and a width of half an arka.
verses.7: And he made two large gold objects, one from each end of the crown.
verses.8: One end of this piece, and one end from that side, were made by joining them together at both ends.
verses.9: And the cherubim had wings that extended upward; their wings covered their bodies. Their faces were facing each other, towards the throne. That was the appearance of the cherubim.
verses.10: And he made the altar of stone, with its length being a true cubit, its width also a true cubit, and its height half a cubit.
verses.11: And they covered him with pure gold, and made around him a golden frame.
verses.12: And he made a frame around it, and he also made a golden ring around the frame.
verses.13: And he gave him four golden bracelets. He placed the bracelets on each of the four feet of his legs.
verses.14: For the purpose of sealing, the tablets were placed in separate rooms, so that they could be used to seal the documents.
verses.15: And he made the lamps from cypress wood. He also covered them with gold so that they could hold the sacred vessels.
verses.16: And he prepared all the dishes that were on the table: his bowls, cups, and other containers. He also prepared the utensils in which gold was poured.
verses.17: And he made the menorah from pure gold. He also made its pedestal and its cups, as well as its flowers.
verses.18: And from her side, five branches emerge. Three of these branches come from one side, and three more branches come from the other side.
verses.19: Three flowers bloom in one stem; they have both leaves and flowers. Similarly, three flowers bloom in one stem, with both leaves and flowers. This applies to all six stems that grow from the root.
verses.20: And in the flowerbed, there are four plants that bloom like flowers.
verses.21: And cover both sides of the holes with it. Cover both sides of the holes with it, so that there are six holes remaining from those two holes.
verses.22: Their bracelets and ornaments, when they purchased them from her, were all made of pure gold.
verses.23: And he made her ornaments from gold: seven rings, bracelets, and other pieces made of gold.
verses.24: He made it from pure gold, and all its utensils were also made of gold.
verses.25: And he made the altar of the incense from acacia wood. Its length was very long, and its width also. Its corners were pointed.
verses.26: And they covered it with pure gold, both on its surface and around its edges. They also made golden branches around it.
verses.27: And two golden chains were made for him, beneath his neck. They were attached to both sides of his body, so that he could carry him there.
verses.28: And he made the bracelets from gold. He also covered them with gold.
verses.29: And he made the wine for sacrifices holy, and also made the utensils used for sacrifices unclean, as a result of his wicked actions.
